metadata.name: breakroom
metadata.description: BREAKROOM: provably fair live card breaks with a live spot market, on MagicBlock Private Ephemeral Rollups

instructions.name: demo_card

accounts.name: vrf_program_identity
docs: Scoped VRF identity PDA, bound to this program. Its presence as a signer proves
the callback was issued by the VRF program for this program.

instructions.name: rip

accounts.name: profile
docs: The caller's profile (wallet or its session key): the host may start early.

fields.name: sold_out_at
docs: When the last spot sold (0 while some are left).

fields.name: shuffle_requested_at
docs: Sale closed / VRF requested.

fields.name: next_reveal_ms
docs: Earliest time the next card may be revealed.

fields.name: host_revenue
docs: What the host has been paid for spots (net of the protocol fee). Paid instantly, buyer
to host, at the moment of each sale: the protocol never holds anyone's USDC.

fields.name: box_value
docs: Total appraised value of the box.

fields.name: auction_end
docs: Auction mode: bidding closes at this unix time (set when the sale opens).

fields.name: commitment
docs: sha256 over every card mint + appraised value, fixed before a single spot sells.

fields.name: revealed
docs: Position -> card index + 1 (0 = still sealed). Position p belongs to spot p / per_spot.

fields.name: spot_cost
docs: What the current owner paid for the spot (for P&L in the UI).

fields.name: ask
docs: 0 = not listed.

fields.name: bid
docs: Best standing offer. Offers aren't escrowed: when the owner accepts, the spot is reserved
for the bidder at that price and the bidder's session fills it.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Accepted offer: only this wallet may buy the spot at `ask` until `reserve_until`.

fields.name: open_order
docs: Order in which spots open (from the VRF output; public once the shuffle lands).

fields.name: spot_team
docs: Team mode: element bitmask each spot owns (0 = not revealed yet).

fields.name: bid_count
docs: Auction mode: how many sealed bids each spot has (the amounts stay sealed).

fields.name: card_elem
docs: Element of each card (Card.art % 8): decides its owner in team mode.

fields.name: cursor
docs: Cards revealed so far.

fields.name: seed_source
docs: 1 = shuffled from VRF; 2 = the VRF never answered and the TEE seeded it (flagged in the UI).

fields.name: settle_sent
docs: The settling commit has been sent (the crank tries every interval; only the first counts).

fields.name: mode
docs: 0 = packs (each spot owns a sealed pack), 1 = random teams (each spot draws elements).

fields.name: teams_out
docs: Team mode: spots whose team has been revealed.

fields.name: sale
docs: Sale: 0 = fixed price, 1 = sealed-bid auction; 2 = auction closed.

fields.name: rip_armed
docs: Packs mode: 1 while the next pack is up and its owner may rip it (until next_reveal_ms).

types.name: Card
docs: The appraisal desk's record for one card NFT. Hosts can't write it: the price a buyer sees
next to a card comes from here, not from the host's listing.

fields.name: value
docs: Market value in USDC base units (6 decimals).

fields.name: grade
docs: Grade x10 (100 = gem mint 10).

fields.name: art
docs: Seeds the card's artwork on the client.

types.name: Faucet
docs: Devnet only: when a wallet last used the test-USDC faucet.

types.name: Profile
docs: A player: display name, the session key allowed to act for them inside the TEE, and stats.
Created on Solana and delegated, so binding a new session key is instant and free.

types.name: Receipt
docs: Base layer. Written by the post-commit Magic Action once the break has ended: which wallet
receives each card. `claim` reads only this, so cards can be delivered while the Break stays
delegated.

fields.name: recipient
docs: Card index -> recipient.

fields.name: claimed
docs: Bit i = card i delivered.
